role: Latest user-directed working revenue case; independent of prior issuer-guidance benchmark
flat_rule: Hold non-ARC operating other revenue at Q3 2026 level in each future quarter; no separate incremental USYC uplift
limitations: Residual ordinary other amount is approximate because ARC recognition is disclosed rounded to $0.1m

Prior dated forecasts are retained; do not blend the guidance benchmark into this case
